title: Secret Reference API

opaque_ref.description: Secret handles are opaque references and reject raw secret-shaped values.
opaque_ref.claim_boundary: No credential-store plaintext is exposed by this local contract. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

brokered_use.description: Secret use is brokered through a callback and supplies no stored plaintext to connector code.
brokered_use.claim_boundary: The local contract uses a broker sentinel; live vault integration is deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

rotation.description: Rotation is denied unless reauthentication is explicitly present.
rotation.claim_boundary: No remote or persistent credential rotation is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

delete.description: Deletion is denied unless reauthentication is explicitly present.
delete.claim_boundary: No credential-store deletion is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

redaction.description: Token-like values, secret references, and diagnostic material are redacted.
redaction.claim_boundary: Redaction is structural for this local API; production log sinks remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

reauth.description: Sensitive operations require an explicit reauthentication result and fail closed otherwise.
reauth.claim_boundary: No interactive reauthentication flow is started locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local opaque-reference contract, not a credential-store integration.
No plaintext secret, token, password, or API key is stored or returned.
Live vault, provider, and external security evidence remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
